description_en: Performs a paging query on the HiMarket consumer list. You can filter consumers by name keywords, portal ID, and developer ID. The response includes the ID, name, description, and primary status of each consumer
description_zh: 分页查询 HiMarket Consumer 列表，可按 Consumer 名称关键词以及门户 ID、开发者 ID 作为查询条件筛选，每个消费者返回消费者 ID、名称、描述以及是否为主消费者
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-hi-market-consumers --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name consumer-1 --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --developer-id dev-xxxxxxxx --max-results 10 --next-token token-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHiMarketConsumers

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for the consumer name
parameters.help_zh: Consumer 名称的搜索关键词
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The portal ID. This parameter is used to filter consumers by portal
parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，作为按门户筛选 Consumer 的查询条件
parameters.name: portal_id

parameters.help_en: The developer ID. This parameter is used to filter consumers by developer
parameters.help_zh: 开发者 ID，作为按开发者筛选 Consumer 的查询条件
parameters.name: developer_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. The default value and valid values are not specified in the API definition
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数。默认值与取值范围未在接口定义中声明
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. To retrieve the next page, pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 以获取下一页，首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

content.description_en: The list of consumers. Each element represents a HiMarket consumer
content.description_zh: Consumer 列表，列表元素名为 consumer，每个元素为一个 HiMarket 消费者

consumerId.description_en: The consumer ID. You can use this ID to locate the consumer in operations such as GetHiMarketConsumer, DeleteHiMarketConsumer, GetHiMarketConsumerCredential, and ListHiMarketConsumerSubscriptions
consumerId.description_zh: 消费者 ID。可用于 GetHiMarketConsumer、DeleteHiMarketConsumer、GetHiMarketConsumerCredential、ListHiMarketConsumerSubscriptions 等接口定位该消费者

isPrimary.description_en: Indicates whether the consumer is a primary consumer
isPrimary.description_zh: 标识该消费者是否为主消费者

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries on the current page

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that the last page has been reached
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。为空表示已到末页
